function.name: weather_forecast_get_prediction
function.description: Fetches the weather prediction for a specified location and date range, including temperature, precipitation chances, and wind speed. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The geographical location for which the weather forecast is requested, in the format of 'City, State' or 'City, Country', such as 'Berkeley, CA' or 'London, UK'.

start_date.description: The start date for the forecast period, in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

end_date.description: The end date for the forecast period, in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

units.description: The unit system used for the weather forecast results.

include_details.description: A flag indicating whether to include detailed forecast information such as hourly data.

### The “Best” Men’s Underwear Styles – A Quick Guide When it comes to men’s underwear, “best” is a mix of comfort, fit, durability, and style. Below is a rundown of the most popular styles, what they’re best for, and key features to look for when shopping. | Style | What It Looks Like | Ideal For | Key Features | |-------|--------------------|-----------|--------------| | **Boxer Briefs** | Long‑legged briefs that cover the hips and thighs. | Everyday wear, gym, travel. | • Full coverage, supportive waistband.
• Good for preventing chafing.
• Available in cotton, modal, microfiber, and performance blends. | | **Briefs (Classic)** | Short‑legged, snug fit with a defined waistband. | Casual, office, light activity. | • Minimal coverage, low profile.
• Great for tight pants.
• Usually made of cotton or a cotton‑blend. | | **Boxers** | Loose, long‑legged, relaxed fit. | Sleep, lounging, casual. | • Breathable, airy.
• Can be prone to bunching under tight pants.
• Often made of cotton or bamboo. | | **Trunks** | Short‑legged, similar to briefs but with a slightly longer leg. | Sports, everyday wear. | • Combines support of briefs with a bit more coverage.
• Often made of moisture‑wicking fabrics. | | **Performance/Tech Underwear** | Designed for athletes or active lifestyles. | Workouts, running, cycling. | • Moisture‑wicking, anti‑odor, quick‑dry.
• Seamless or flat‑lock seams to reduce friction. | | **Compression Briefs** | Tight, supportive fit that compresses the lower abdomen. | Post‑surgery, high‑intensity training, long flights. | • Helps with circulation and muscle support.
• Usually made of spandex blends. | | **Bamboo or Modal** | Made from plant‑based fibers. | Sensitive skin, eco‑conscious shoppers. | • Ultra‑soft, breathable, naturally antibacterial.
• Good moisture management. | | **Lace or Decorative** | Stylish, often with lace or printed patterns. | Special occasions, gifts. | • Fashion‑forward, not necessarily functional for sports. | --- ## How to Pick the Right Style 1. **Consider Your Daily Activities** - **Active Lifestyle** → Performance briefs or trunks. - **Office/Business Casual** → Classic briefs or boxer briefs. - **Sleep/Lounge** → Boxers or soft cotton briefs. 2. **Fabric Matters** - **Cotton** – Breathable, natural, but can absorb sweat. - **Modal/Bamboo** – Soft, moisture‑wicking, eco‑friendly. - **Microfiber/Polyester** – Durable, quick‑dry, often used in performance gear. - **Spandex/Lycra** – Adds stretch and shape retention. 3. **Fit & Comfort** - **Waistband** – Should sit at the natural waist without digging. - **Seam Placement** – Flat‑lock seams reduce irritation. - **Length** – Boxers can be too long for tight pants; briefs may be too short for some. 4. **Special Needs** - **Sensitive Skin** – Look for hypoallergenic fabrics, avoid dyes. - **Medical Conditions** – Compression briefs can aid circulation. - **Travel** – Pack a mix of briefs and boxers for versatility. 5. **Style & Color** - Neutral colors (black, navy, gray) are versatile. - Bright colors or patterns can add personality. - For a gift, consider a set of different styles. --- ## Top Brands (as of 2026) | Brand | Known For | Best Style | |-------|-----------|------------| | **Calvin Klein** | Iconic briefs & boxer briefs | Classic briefs | | **Hanes** | Affordable, durable | Boxer briefs | | **Under Armour** | Performance tech | Performance briefs | | **Uniqlo** | Simple, high‑quality basics | Boxer briefs | | **Tommy John** | Comfort‑centric, seamless | Boxer briefs | | **Saxx** | Innovative pouch design | Boxer briefs | | **Bamboo Body** | Eco‑friendly fibers | Bamboo briefs | | **Lululemon** | Athletic, moisture‑wicking | Performance briefs | --- ## Quick Tips for Buying - **Try Before You Buy** – If possible, test a few styles in-store. - **Check Return Policy** – Many online retailers offer easy returns. - **Read Reviews** – Look for comments on fit, durability, and wash‑after‑wash performance. - **Buy in Sets** – Bulk purchases often come with a discount and a variety of styles. --- ### Bottom Line - **Boxer briefs** are the all‑rounder: supportive, comfortable, and versatile. - **Briefs** are great for a low‑profile look under tight clothing. - **Boxers** are best for relaxed, breathable comfort. - **Performance underwear** is essential if you’re active or traveling long distances. Pick the style that matches your lifestyle, pay attention to fabric and fit, and you’ll find underwear that feels like a second skin. Happy shopping!
